text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Y-yeah, I'm fine! I'm, um... just a
little
hungry...

I'M GONNA GIVE TODAY MY
AAAALLL!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that felt good! Nothing like some
good ol'
yelling to clear your mind of
gloomy feelings!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Clear your mind... of gloomy thoughts...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
WHAT DO I HAVE TO DO TO BECOME
COOLER
AND MORE DEPENDABLE?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's still hung up on what
happened at
the amusement park with
Biko Pegasus and Hishi
Akebono a while
back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! You wanna be cool and
dependable?
That's such a great goal!
You're living life to the
full!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how long it will take to
achieve or
even how I'd make it
happen...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But since I've set my sights on that goal,
I'm not
going to give up on it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, that's easy, Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just go and observe people you think
are reliable!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right—there's no one more
reliable
than a doctor! They make your
stomachaches go
away and stuff, after
all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-exactly! Even in TV shows, you always
see these
cool doctors who enter the
scene and say
reassuring things like, "I'll
save you no matter
what!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hey, look over there.

text_block_list.name: Patient
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for all your help,
Doctor.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on being discharged...
To think I
once thought you wouldn't
recover. I owe you my
deepest apologies
for my thoughtless comments.

text_block_list.name: Patient
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. Your
honesty is
what made me trust you. I
could tell you were
sincere.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Getting discharged is definitely
something
to celebrate! What great
news for both of them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Telling a patient you're not sure if
they'll
recover, though? That doesn't
exactly make the
doctor seem very
reliable... and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, sorry! Let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you dunno what this flower is?!
Why not? I
thought teachers knew
everything!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of things I don't know.
Everyone's
the same. What do you do
when you don't know
something?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Umm... I look it up and study it!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I'll read up on this flower so I
can tell you
all about it the next time we
see one. Now we
both have a reason to
study hard!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... That reminds me of the time I
made
sakura mochi with my teacher a
long time ago...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Was your teacher a master patissier
of
Japanese desserts?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, they were actually really bad at
cooking, but
they did their very best to
research different
recipes for me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And that made me really happy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I get it now... Being dependable must
mean...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! Where should we go next?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What?! But we were just getting started!
I bet you
still wanna keep going too,
right, Chiyo? I mean,
you haven't found
your answer yet!
choice_data_list: We have tomorrow to think about, so maybe we should wrap it up...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I think I'm good! Thank you for
your
help, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I did... Or I guess I should say I realized
that I
might've been on the right track
all along...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm still an unreliable mess,
and I'm
extremely far away from my
goal...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But now I know that as long as I keep on
this
path, I'll become the person I want
to be
eventually.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I just have to do what I do best and work
my butt
off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I just have to do what I do best and work
my butt
off!
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, alright?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Y-yeah. I need to make sure I don't
repeat my
mistakes from the amusement
park.
choice_data_list: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Don't push yourself too hard, alright?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best not to do more than my
best so I
can do my best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: More than your best to... Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You lost me there, but I know you can
do it,
Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then let's start off on the right
foot and
run back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! You wanna start by putting
your all
into your usual training too,
huh?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaall righty, then! I can help you with
that!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O, G-O!
Tickezo, G-O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so I end up rushing to chase after
them as
they sprint back to the academy
at full speed!
